findings.reason: 'settings' is rendered as 参数 here but as 设置 in the next step, an inconsistency within the same list; the required UI rendering is 设置.

findings.span: 请参考ComfyUI的官方文档
findings.suggestion: 请参考 ComfyUI 的文档
findings.reason: Adds '官方' (official), which is not stated in the English source ('ComfyUI's documentation'). Also omits the 'compatible system' requirement mentioned in the source.

findings.span: 制作带有AI视觉效果的宣传视频。
findings.suggestion: 制作带有 AI 视觉效果的宣传视频。
findings.reason: Missing spaces between Latin acronym 'AI' and surrounding Chinese text; the rest of the entry (description, metaDescription) consistently spaces Latin terms, so this is internally inconsistent. Same issue in '探索AI驱动的视频叙事创作。'

findings.span: 例如 “Save frames” 和 “Save videos”
findings.suggestion: 例如“Save frames”和“Save videos”
findings.reason: Extra ASCII spaces before/around full-width Chinese quotation marks; howToUse renders the same pattern without spaces (“Prompts generator & settings”), so the page is inconsistent.

findings.span: 并将其连接为负向 conditioning
findings.suggestion: 并将其连接为负面条件（negative conditioning）
findings.reason: The UI term 'conditioning' must be rendered as 条件 per the required glossary; it was left untranslated in English.

findings.span: 具备时间感知的 latent 生成
findings.suggestion: 具备时间感知的 Latent 生成
findings.reason: Glossary requires 'latent' to appear as 'Latent' (capitalized); lowercase 'latent' is used here and again in '将 latent 转为 RGB 帧'.

findings.span: 用于解说片头或标题动画
findings.suggestion: 解说短片片段或片头字幕序列
findings.reason: 'Explainer snippets or title sequences' is collapsed into one item; 'snippets' (short clips) is lost and 'explainer' is merged with 'title sequence'.

findings.span: 用电影风格提示词生成风格化汽车或产品镜头。
findings.suggestion: 使用电影感提示词与胶片质感调色，生成风格化的汽车或产品镜头。
findings.reason: Omits 'film looks' (film-style color/grade), which the English lists separately from 'cinematic prompts'.

findings.span: 查看已生成图像，并在需要时使用 MarkdownNote 节点记录与整理调整内容。
findings.suggestion: 查看已生成图像，并使用 MarkdownNote 节点进行记录，做出任何必要的调整。
findings.reason: The English instructs the user to 'make any necessary adjustments' with the MarkdownNote node used 'for documentation'; the translation collapses this into 'record and organize adjustment content', losing the instruction to actually make adjustments.

findings.span: 该工作流更偏向高质量图像生成，而非实时应用。
findings.suggestion: 虽然该工作流功能强大，但它针对高质量图像生成进行了优化，而非实时应用。
findings.reason: Omits the concessive clause 'While the workflow is powerful' present in the English answer.

findings.span: 海报场景样机生成
findings.suggestion: 海报场景样机
findings.reason: The English title 'Poster Scene Mockups' is a noun phrase; the translation adds '生成' (generate), which is not in the source, and it conflicts with the workflow name rendered as '海报场景样机' in the extendedDescription.

findings.span: “海报场景样机”工作流
findings.suggestion: “海报场景样机生成”工作流 (or align the title to 海报场景样机)
findings.reason: The workflow name is quoted differently here than in the title and howToUse ('海报场景样机生成'), creating inconsistent naming across the page.

findings.span: 运行工作流，自动处理输入并生成样机。
findings.suggestion: 运行工作流，让你的输入经过各个节点处理。
findings.reason: Omits 'through the various nodes' and adds 'generate mockups', which is not stated in this step.

findings.span: 通过SaveImage节点保存生成的样机图。
findings.suggestion: 使用SaveImage节点查看并保存生成的样机。
findings.reason: Omits 'Review' from 'Review and save the generated mockups'.

findings.span: 可节省制作样机的时间与成本
findings.suggestion: 可节省制作样机的时间与资源
findings.reason: 'resources' is rendered as '成本' (cost), narrowing the meaning of the source.

findings.span: Seedance 2.0 Mini：Reference to Video
findings.suggestion: Seedance 2.0 Mini：参考图生成视频
findings.reason: The workflow name is translated in the title field ('参考图生成视频') but left in English here, making the page inconsistent.

findings.span: 两张静态图像合成为一段统一的电影感视频
findings.suggestion: 两张静态图像合成为单个电影感视频
findings.reason: 'single' means one video output; '统一' ('unified') is not what the English says.

findings.span: 也可以同时输入到两个端口
findings.suggestion: 也可以同时输入到两个输入
findings.reason: 'inputs' is a product-UI term that must be rendered 输入, not 端口.

findings.span: 社交媒体预告与 teaser
findings.suggestion: 社交媒体预告片与短预告
findings.reason: Mixing an untranslated English word 'teaser' with its near-synonym 预告 reads redundant and unpolished in Chinese.

findings.span: 在两张引导静帧之间探索光照、服装与构图连贯性
findings.suggestion: 基于两张引导静帧探索光照、服装与构图连贯性
findings.reason: English says 'from two guiding stills'; '之间' introduces a 'between' relation not present in the source.

findings.span: 自动优化提示词
findings.suggestion: 并支持提示词优化
findings.reason: The English says 'with prompt optimization'; the translation adds 'automatic' (自动), a capability claim not present in the source.

findings.span: 根据文本课程大纲生成教育视频
findings.suggestion: 根据文本教案生成教育视频
findings.reason: 'lesson plans' is rendered as 课程大纲 (course outline); 教案 is the accurate term for lesson plans.

findings.span: Sprite Sheet 动画生成器
findings.suggestion: Sprite Sheet 生成器
findings.reason: The title adds '动画' (animation), which is not present in the English title 'Sprite Sheet Generator'.

findings.span: 上传你的 sprite 图像
findings.suggestion: 上传你的精灵图像
findings.reason: 'sprite' is left untranslated here while it is rendered as '精灵' everywhere else in the entry (description, extendedDescription, FAQ), creating inconsistent terminology across the page.

findings.span: 为交互媒体内容设计动画精灵
findings.suggestion: 使用动画精灵设计交互媒体内容
findings.reason: Reverses the English relation: the source is about designing interactive media content using animated sprites, not designing the sprites for the content.

findings.span: denoise 强度（如 0.35–0.6）
findings.reason: Inconsistent rendering within the same entry: the FAQ translates 'denoise strength' as 去噪强度 while howToUse leaves it as English 'denoise'.

findings.span: 如有暴露参数
findings.suggestion: 如果界面中提供了这些参数
findings.reason: Literal rendering of 'If exposed'; 暴露参数 is unnatural Chinese for exposed/available node settings.

findings.span: 在半透明角标类水印上也更稳
findings.suggestion: 在半透明的角落 Logo 水印上效果更稳定
findings.reason: Colloquial '更稳' is too informal for the descriptive register of the rest of the page.

findings.span: Krea 2：风格参考生成
findings.suggestion: Krea 2：风格参考
findings.reason: The title adds '生成' (generation), which is not present in the English title 'Krea 2: Style Reference'. Titles should stay concise and match the source.

findings.span: 如需融合多种风格，可按作者提示串联多个风格节点
findings.suggestion: 如需融合多种风格，可按作者提示通过风格节点串联更多参考图像
findings.reason: English says to chain additional reference images through the style node(s); the translation says to chain multiple style nodes, shifting the object of the instruction.

findings.span: 可通过优化提示词、调整风格参考顺序或风格强度（如有）迭代结果。
findings.suggestion: 可通过优化提示词、替换或重新排列风格参考，或调整风格强度（如有）来增强或减弱参考的影响，进行迭代。
findings.reason: Omits 'swapping' style references and the clause 'to increase or decrease the influence of the reference' from the source.

findings.span: 而后面的参考可以推动细节
findings.suggestion: 而后面的参考可以微调细节
findings.reason: '推动细节' is an unnatural rendering of 'nudge details'; a native speaker would say 微调/影响细节.

findings.span: 循环视频制作：找到最佳匹配帧，打造更干净的循环点。
findings.suggestion: 循环制作：找到近乎完美的匹配帧，为背景视频打造更干净的循环点。
findings.reason: Omits 'for background videos' and softens 'near-perfect match frame' to '最佳匹配帧'.

findings.span: 生成额外帧以实现更平滑的剪切或溶解衔接
findings.suggestion: 生成额外帧以实现更平滑的匹配剪辑（match-cut）或便于叠化的衔接
findings.reason: 'match-cuts' is a specific editing term rendered as generic '剪切', losing the meaning.

findings.span: VFX预演：在正式补拍前，为场景延长镜头。
findings.suggestion: VFX临时素材：在决定补拍前，于预演（pre-vis）中延长定场镜头。
findings.reason: 'VFX temping' is not '预演', 'pre-vis' is dropped, and 'establishing shots' is flattened to '场景'.

findings.span: 无缝延长镜头以延长主体展示，无跳切。
findings.suggestion: 延长镜头以在主体上停留更久，且不出现明显跳切。
findings.reason: Repetition of 延长...延长 reads awkwardly; '无缝' is added and not in the English source.

findings.span: 扩展
findings.suggestion: 外扩
findings.reason: 'Outpainting' is rendered as 外扩 in the metaDescription, howToUse and FAQ but as 扩展 here and in extendedDescription; use one consistent term across the page.

findings.span: 物体移除
findings.suggestion: 对象移除
findings.reason: 'Object removal' is translated as 对象移除 in the description and extendedDescription but 物体移除 here; inconsistent terminology within the same page.

findings.span: 选择在 “Maskeditor” 中打开
findings.suggestion: 选择“在 Maskeditor 中打开”
findings.reason: Stray space before the Chinese opening quotation mark and the quoted UI command is split awkwardly; the quoted menu item should enclose the whole command.

findings.span: Comfy广告选角预演
findings.suggestion: Comfy 广告 - 演员选角
findings.reason: The English title 'Comfy for Advertising - Talent Casting' does not contain 'previs'; the translation adds 预演 (previsualization), which is information not present in the source title.

findings.span: 例如无意更改发色
findings.suggestion: 例如更改发色
findings.reason: The English example is simply 'changing hair color'; adding 无意 ('unintentionally') introduces meaning not in the source and conflicts with the following clause '除非你确实要这么做' (unless intentional).

findings.span: 并在可能的情况下通过 LoadImage 提供产品/环境图像
findings.suggestion: 如果有的话，可通过 LoadImage 提供产品/环境图像
findings.reason: 'if available' refers to having the images on hand, not 'if possible' (在可能的情况下), which shifts the meaning.

findings.span: 生成选角定帧
findings.suggestion: 生成选角静帧
findings.reason: 'still' is rendered as 静帧 in the extendedDescription but as 定帧 in howToUse and metaDescription; the same term should be used consistently across the page.

findings.span: 通常能在跨帧保持一致
findings.suggestion: 通常能在各帧之间保持一致
findings.reason: '在跨帧保持一致' is ungrammatical Chinese; 跨帧 cannot follow 在...保持.

findings.span: 图像到图像引导式合成
findings.suggestion: 图生图引导式合成
findings.reason: metaDescription renders image-to-image as 图生图 and image-to-video as 图生视频, while extendedDescription uses 图像到图像 and 图像转视频; inconsistent terminology within the same entry.

findings.span: 作为所有变换的基础图片
findings.suggestion: 作为所有变换的基础图像
findings.reason: Product-UI term 'image' must be rendered as 图像, not 图片, for consistency with the ComfyUI app glossary.

findings.span: 使用发型变换工作流
findings.suggestion: 使用发型变换器工作流
findings.reason: The workflow name is rendered '发型变换器' in the title but '发型变换' here; inconsistent naming within the same entry.

findings.span: 测试风格化的颜色与形状，不做永久改变
findings.suggestion: 测试风格化的颜色与形状以匹配角色，且无需做出永久改变
findings.reason: Omits the English 'to match a character', losing the stated purpose of the test.
